title: Base Node Schema
description: Base schema for all node types in the IGVF Catalog. Defines common required properties.

_key.description: Unique identifier for this record within its collection. Key composition is collection-specific: a stable source accession where one exists, otherwise a composite of the fields that make the record unique.

name.description: Human-readable display label for this record. Not guaranteed to be unique.

source_url.description: Link to the specific upstream record or file this data was loaded from.
